prerequisites: Director grants positive spend and claim authority.
A compatible nvidia-h200-sxm bench is available after the current claimant releases.
All consumed pinned-runtime and candidate bytes are materialized under this project, hashed, and transferred from that immutable project-local snapshot.

global.register_live_state_estimate: 4 query rows x 8 query heads x d512 FP32 output accumulators plus Q fragments: about 128 KiB of 32-bit register state per CTA before overhead, implying one-CTA-per-SM pressure that must be compiler-checked.
global.shared_memory_estimate: One BF16 K+V d512 x N32 tile: 64 KiB before barriers/staging.

local.register_live_state_estimate: 12 query rows x 2 query heads x d256 FP32 output accumulators plus Q fragments: about 48 KiB of 32-bit register state per CTA before overhead.
local.shared_memory_estimate: One BF16 K+V d256 x N64 tile: 64 KiB before barriers/staging.

candidate.mechanism: Flatten query-position x GQA-head into the dot-product M tile inside each request/KV-head CTA so each paged K/V tile is loaded once for the whole GQA group. The q-tile-zero CTA stores the 12 normalized/rotated K/V rows to the exact page-size-1 NHD future-cache slots. Per output row, key traversal and online-softmax order remain the stock order.

component: Use Q/K/V emitted by the pinned qkv_proj -> fused QKV RMSNorm -> RoPE producer, not synthetic GPU tensors.
Use exact page_size=1 NHD BF16 cache buffers, noncontiguous page indices, out_cache_loc, request ownership, local SWA translation, and production NGRAM full masks.
After every invocation, consume every attention output through the unchanged exact o_proj.
Require bitwise-identical BF16 attention output, o_proj output, and newly stored K/V bytes versus stock. Any mismatch is a semantic negative for this exact-order candidate.
Cover full M384 local d256/GQA2/window1024 and global d512/GQA8 contexts, plus page-boundary, partial-active-request, padded/no-op slot, branching-tree, zero, tiny, and large finite values.
endpoint: Require identical target logits bit-for-bit, identical selected target tokens, identical accepted-token counts and indices, identical request completion order, and identical KV ownership over the qualified c32 NGRAM workload.
A numerically close but non-bitwise result does not satisfy this project's exact-logit mechanism.

falsifiers: Compiler reports more than 255 registers per thread, spills, illegal shared memory, or no launchable SM90a object for either production family.
Any bitwise attention, o_proj, target-logit, accepted-token, cache-byte, mask, or request-ownership mismatch.
Measured candidate L2 read bytes do not fall for either family, showing stock cache reuse already realizes the proposed mechanism.
Candidate component latency does not improve after at least three alternating valid repetitions per family.
A positive component result becomes non-positive in the matched endpoint.

hardware.driver_runtime: Record exact bench driver, CUDA, Triton, SGLang image digest, GPU UUID, and clock state.

identities.workload: c32 NGRAM, 12 target rows/request, M384, TP1

arms: candidate grouped-head attention + fused future-KV store
component.attribution: CUDA events around the complete store-plus-attention boundary; compilation/autotune excluded; synchronize after each arm's first untimed call and persist an arm marker.
component.repetitions: At least A/B/A/B/A/B with warm caches and enough inner iterations for stable event timing; preserve every raw sample.
required_metrics: median, p10, p90 store-plus-attention latency per family
local-memory load/store sectors and compiler spills
component.statistics: Use the repository bracketed A/B analyzer with an experiment-bound seed and report paired 95% bootstrap intervals.

endpoint.gate: Run immediately if both exact families are correct and the layer-count-weighted component delta is positive; incremental wins are admissible.
endpoint.metric: Qualified service seconds/request and sustainable cost at the locked c32 workload, plus target-verification attention critical-path time.
endpoint.repetitions: At least three alternating complete control/candidate repetitions, preserving raw requests, outputs, target events, and per-request latency.
endpoint.success: Positive paired endpoint improvement with no quality, completion, reliability, or memory-capacity regression. This component cannot itself satisfy the campaign's 0.500119281574996 s/request terminal objective without the measured endpoint.

promotion.component_only_claim_limit: Exact-shape H200 component result only; do not transfer to whole-request latency.
promotion.required_next_gate: Scope-matched qualified c32 NGRAM endpoint A/B through the exact producer and first downstream o_proj.
promotion.stock_control: Pinned Triton target-verify set_kv_buffer plus extend_attention_fwd, not a synthetic attention implementation.
